C03.target: Conservar H2: heartbeat 5 ms, retraso p95 <=25 ms y máximo <=75 ms; cancelación <=100 ms, parada simulada <=200 ms, cleanup cooperativo <=1 s; PCM exacto y colas acotadas.
C03.minimum_evidence: Diez repeticiones y productores simulados de 200 ms, incluidas respuestas largas y trabajo nativo retenido.

C04.target: Inventario completo de productores/SDK/copias, mute total durable reactivable sin voz, vencimiento/borrado sin resurrección en restauración compatible.
C04.minimum_evidence: Casos con inicialización, escritura, modelo, transporte y frontend tardíos; ningún participante desconocido permite afirmar borrado total.

C05.target: Suite completa y checks requeridos sin fallos ni xfail en requisitos incluidos; artefacto CPython 3.13 verificado fuera de fuentes y rollback de runtime/datos probado.
C05.minimum_evidence: Candidato exacto, dependencias reproducibles y hashes; configuración de arranque validada, entrenamiento nocturno deshabilitado si su utilidad/recursos no están aceptados; advertencias nuevas de aplicación justificadas, sin ocultarlas indiscriminadamente.

compatible_restore_definition: Use explicitly registered supported-version participant locations and known snapshot provenance. Preserve the current privacy ledger/deletion intent and writer lease generation; never restore an older authority DB over tombstones and call the resulting state a valid bypass.

Keep root/descriptor/file identity checks. A replaced/unrecognized root or unsupported version remains unknown/pending; do not bypass checks, edit journal state manually or delete foreign files to manufacture success.
Do not stub remaining participants as complete. Assert selected real participant steps only; aggregate completion requires every actual required driver/target.
No ordinary-data promotion into a new training corpus; original capture/deadline/source/consent continue through every compatible restored descendant.
concrete_first_proofs: Existing public API characterization: create two supported descendants, take consistent synthetic snapshots, request authenticated erasure, and record actual selected step/file/row receipts. This is not a missing-API RED.

After a leased restart, restore both named participant data snapshots behind prior complete receipts while keeping tombstones current; rebuild/reconcile through real builders. Restored revoked rows/files cannot be served or newly indexed and are physically cleaned before their step completes; unrelated live source remains byte/state-identical.

Hold one actual encoder/unlink/index operation through observer cancellation while another participant finishes. The held/unknown participant prevents aggregate complete; after real return, same claim/version recheck and no late publication/resurrection.
Corrupt/missing/replaced historical root or unsupported protocol retains explicit pending/unknown and does not create replacement storage or remove foreign payloads.
next_unit.production_change_rule: Start with rehearsal and exact outcome. If a genuine source failure appears, propose the smallest coherent fix at that observed boundary (journal/recovery plus one selected participant); no speculative restore framework or blanket SDK wipe.
later_acceptance: Extend the matrix to semantic facts/index, context/event/suggestion/diagnostic/stream/browser/voice targets, CLI durable artifacts, legacy/quarantine/raw exports/adapters and runtime/data rollback before claiming C04 complete.
Compatible real-data/runtime copy rehearsal and physical four-input/iPhone/HA observations remain separately controlled work; local synthetic tests cannot replace them.
